messages:
sam: Heads-up — after the canary deploy the runtime started swapping in v2_fused_attn for long sequences. Seeing ~12% median latency regression at 80 tokens across a few routes. Profiling attached; looks like smem/bw spike.

marta: perf report link?

perf-bot: Automated profile (run=2042103445, env=prod-canary): summary -> v2_fused_attn: ~1.6x shared-memory per-block at seq=2048, noticeable bank conflicts, and global memory BW jump. nvprof lines and lightweight flame attached.

yousef: Could be the kernel chooser heuristic misclassifying because we tightened batch_threshold=16 last week. Current heuristic: `if (avg_batch >= 16 && seq > 1024) choose fused_v2` — that ignores smem/occupancy.

elaine: I pushed a temporary revert for the chooser pins on canary but many workers already swapped. Any quick mitigations besides a full revert?

marta: We can force paged-attn for sequences > 1500 as mitigation; paged reduces per-block smem but adds small compute overhead (~+3% on small kv hit rates).

sam: Quick nvprof top-lines I scraped: SMEM per-block = fused_v2: 96KB, fused_v1: 48KB, paged: 24KB. Observed memory BW peaked ~900GB/s on A100 cluster during the spike.

yousef: Suggestion — try reducing tiling params to lower shared memory per-block. e.g., change tile_m from 64 -> 48 and drop one pipeline stage:

```
tiler.set_tile(m=48, n=64)
tiler.set_pipeline_stages(2) // was 3
```

marta: I ran a microbench on dev-rt1: tile_m=48 reduced peak smem to ~66KB for fused_v2 and latency improved ~6% vs fused_v2 default. Side-effect: slightly higher L2 traffic / marginal thrash.

elaine: We should update the kernel selection score to be smem-aware. Proposed scoring: `score = latency_est + max(0, smem_est - smem_thresh) * penalty` — where smem_est is per-block estimate and penalty tuned by occupancy.

perf-bot: KV-cache note: fused_v2 keeps larger KV live per warp which raised hot-prefix hit ratio, but eviction pressure increased when batches aggregated, causing occasional thrash. Correlate with kv_cache_hitrate metric.

sam: Plan of action: (1) rollback chooser change on canary (done), (2) add smem-aware scoring to chooser (PR #3421), (3) run a 6h canary with fused_v2 tiled m=48, (4) monitor host-level mem BW + kv eviction rate. Any objections?

marta: :thumbsup: no objections. I'll queue PR review and schedule microbench runs.

yousef: I'll add a microbench harness to record occupancy vs smem_per_block for all kernels (fused_v1/v2/paged) and output CSV for the tuner.

elaine: Also logging notes — tag traces with `kernel_id:smem_est` and `kv_cache_hitrate` so console can show correlated spikes. I'll add dashboard panels for those.

perf-bot: Action items recorded: PR #3421, canary rollback verified, mitigation deploy scheduled 14:00 PST. Will post results after 6h canary run.
